en.hubeali: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from one of our companions who said,

‘I asked Abu Abdullahasws about a slaughter by the People of the Book. So heasws said: ‘By Allahazwj! They are not eating from your slaughters, so how are you permitting yourselves that you eat their slaughters? But rather, it is the naming (Bismillah), and none can be relied over it except for a Muslim’.
en.sarwar: 16. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from ibn abu ‘Umayr from certain persons of his people who has said the following: “

I once asked abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, about the animals the people of the book slaughter. He (the Imam) said, ‘By Allah they do not eat what you slaughter; then how can you consider what they slaughter as lawful? It is a matter of name (mentioning the name of Allah), and no one can be trusted in it except a Muslim.’”
